name: Abel
source: The elite warriors at Nirvana acknowledge Abel as the strongest student among them. Since his enrollment, he has gone undefeated, besting even instructors with his overwhelming strength and ability to remain calm in any situation. His communication skills are not nearly as polished, and he often comes across as brusque and cold...but it seems he has a kind side, too?
